title: Fraxetin inhibits IKKbeta, blocks NF-kappaB pathway and NLRP3 inflammasome activation, and alleviates spleen injury in sepsis.
authors: Huangfu, Liwei; Wang, Jing; Li, Da; Fei, Haiyang; Chen, Xuan; Dong, Jingquan; Sun, Lan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物Fraxetin通过分子对接靶向IKKbeta抑制NF-kappaB通路缓解脓毒症脾损伤，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Sepsis is a systemic inflammatory condition associated with severe organ failure, particularly splenic injury. Fraxetin (Fra), a natural product isolated from ash bark, exhibits anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. This study explores the function and mechanism of Fra in sepsis-induced splenic injury using an in vivo mouse model induced by Cecal Ligation and Puncture and an in vitro sepsis model based on LPS/ATP co-stimulated J774A.1 cells. The experimental groups are as follows: Sham operation or control group, Fra control group, CLP or LPS/ATP group, CLP + Fra group or LPS/ATP + Fra group, with Dexamethasone as a positive control. The results indicated that Fra improved the survival rate, inhibited bacteria burden, and reduced spleen edema. Fra also alleviated spleen necrosis, and restored the structural integrity. Blood results showed that Fra restored platelet count and lymphocyte percentage, reduced neutrophil ratio and C-reactive protein increase, and prevented lymphocyte depletion. Immunohistochemistry demonstrated that Fra inhibited MPO levels. Additionally, Fra downregulated Procalcitonin, inhibited pro-inflammatory cytokines, NO release and Arg-1 expression, illustrating its anti-inflammatory effects. DHE staining revealed that Fra inhibited ROS and MDA, enhanced CAT, GSH-PX, and SOD activities. Furthermore, Fra inhibited NLRP3 inflammasome activation, p-IKKbeta expression and NF-kappaB pathway. Mechanistically, molecular docking studies revealed that Fra could bind to IKKbeta, thereby blocking the NF-kappaB pathway and NLRP3 inflammasome, functioning anti-inflammatory effects. In summary, Fra targets IKKbeta to block the NF-kappaB pathway and NLRP3 inflammasome activation, alleviating sepsis-induced splenic injury, making it a promising therapeutic strategy for treating sepsis-induced splenic injury.
abstract_zh: 脓毒症是一种与严重器官衰竭相关的系统性炎症状态，尤其是脾脏损伤。Fraxetin（Fra）是从白蜡树皮中分离出的天然产物，具有抗炎和抗氧化特性。本研究通过体内小鼠模型（由盲肠结扎穿刺诱导）和体外脓毒症模型（基于LPS/ATP共刺激的J774A.1细胞），探讨Fra在脓毒症诱导的脾脏损伤中的功能及机制。实验分组如下：假手术或对照组、Fra对照组、CLP或LPS/ATP组、CLP + Fra组或LPS/ATP + Fra组，并以地塞米松作为阳性对照。结果表明，Fra提高了存活率，抑制了细菌负荷，并减轻了脾脏水肿。Fra还缓解了脾脏坏死，并恢复了结构完整性。血液结果显示，Fra恢复了血小板计数和淋巴细胞百分比，降低了中性粒细胞比例和C反应蛋白升高，并防止了淋巴细胞耗竭。免疫组化显示，Fra抑制了MPO水平。此外，Fra下调了降钙素原，抑制了促炎细胞因子、NO释放和Arg-1表达，体现了其抗炎作用。DHE染色显示，Fra抑制了ROS和MDA，增强了CAT、GSH-PX和SOD活性。进一步地，Fra抑制了NLRP3炎症小体激活、p-IKKbeta表达和NF-kappaB通路。机制上，分子对接研究揭示Fra能与IKKbeta结合，从而阻断NF-kappaB通路和NLRP3炎症小体，发挥抗炎作用。总之，Fra靶向IKKbeta以阻断NF-kappaB通路和NLRP3炎症小体激活，减轻脓毒症诱导的脾脏损伤，使其成为治疗脓毒症诱导脾脏损伤的有前景的治疗策略。
